ValidationRule.description: The user's which are not the owner of the Denial's record should not be able to edit it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), /* Applies only on edit */ $User.Id <> OwnerId, /* User is NOT the owner */ NOT( OR( $Profile.Name = "System Administrator", /* Allow System Admin */ $Profile.Name = "NPP Integration" /* Allow NPP Integration */ ) ), ISCHANGED(dn_Status__c) = FALSE /* They're not just changing the status */ )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only the owner of this Denial record is allowed to make changes.
